_comment: Public-safe default glossary for the caret-cleanup system prompt. Every entry is a term from Caret's own public vocabulary: the contract, the agents it connects to, and the setup nouns a user says out loud. Nothing operator-, person-, host-, or deployment-specific belongs here — a deployment adds its own vocabulary at runtime instead (see README.md). Entries bias spelling and casing only, in context; they are never a blind find-and-replace.

entries.context: The dictation keyboard and the backend contract it speaks. Only when the words around it are about the keyboard, the app, or the backend — an actual carrot stays a carrot.
The current contract identifier, written with a slash and a lowercase v.
The earlier contract identifier, written the same way. Do not renumber a version the speaker said.
An agent backend Caret can connect to. One word, capital G and capital B.
An agent CLI Caret can connect to. Two words, both capitalized.
An agent CLI Caret can connect to.
An agent CLI Caret can connect to.
An agent Caret can connect to. One word, capital O and capital C.
The default local speech-to-text engine. One word, capital O and capital W.
A private network people reach their own backend over. One word, capital T only.
The pairing code the app scans. Capital Q, capital R, lowercase code.
The bearer credential a backend is configured with. Capital A P I, lowercase key.
